_subagent_note: Platform child/forked agents are forbidden and never count as roster members, makers, reviewers, dispatchers, approvers, fallbacks, or evidence.
_id_note: 'id' is a permanent slug. Directory and file paths depend on it: agents/<id>.md, inbox/<id>/, outbox/<id>/, and every script's member validation. Never change an id after installation.
_displayName_note: 'displayName' is the only name field onboarding may rewrite. Rename freely; nothing on disk depends on it.
_authority_note: Exactly one member must hold 'lead'. At most one may hold 'deputy'. Authority controls coordination, never capability - every member is a technical generalist.
_status_note: Only active and dispatchable members receive work or satisfy a review gate. On-leave members keep their seat, identity, and history but receive no work and count toward no gate.
_reactivation_note: Reactivation requires an explicit Trainer order and a recorded governance/worklog update. A reactivated member record may carry reactivatedOn (ISO date) and reactivationOrder; this fresh template has no reactivation history.

Exacting, production-minded, thorough, and focused on completion.
